description.value: A Canadian art gallery in East Vancouver's light-industrial Venables corridor, operating since 1986. Represents BC and North American artists across painting, photography, and digital art with rotating exhibitions. Free admission and no appointment needed on weekdays, making it an easy cultural stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Art Works is an active art gallery operating since 1986 at 1536 Venables Street with free admission. Phone (604.688.3301) and address match OSM tags exactly. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. All required criteria and optional amenities remain null due to absence of evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active free-admission art gallery on Venables Street in East Vancouver, a common urban cycling corridor. A legitimate cultural stop for touring cyclists, though cycling-specific amenities are unconfirmed.
